admission.justification: Weighed storing/scanning explainer content under onboarding/ and hand-rolled YAML parsing against strict docs/{concepts,stages}/ isolation and PyYAML pure models, constraining Leaf 05 Stage 00 authoring and all downstream explainer stages.

alternatives.option: Scope explainer validation strictly to <memory>/docs/{concepts,stages}/ (never AR onboarding/), add PyYAML>=6.0 and types-PyYAML>=6.0 for pure zero-I/O frontmatter parsing in models/concepts.py, allow mutual cycles between distinct Concept Cards while rejecting self-cycles, and exempt Level-2/3 prose from jargon-before-reveal.
alternatives.reason: Keeps public explainer prose cleanly decoupled from internal code-onboarding cards, preserves strict Pyright and models/ I/O purity with standard YAML parsing, supports mutually explanatory classical concepts, and preserves rigorous undergrad/formal prose in Levels 2 and 3.

alternatives.option: Store public explainer pages inside onboarding/ or scan AR onboarding/ code cards with the Abitur Level-1 jargon validator.
alternatives.reason: Conflates internal engineering contracts with public Abitur-level mathematical exposition and would cause pervasive false jargon-before-reveal failures on code-onboarding cards.
alternatives.reconsider_when: A future approved requirement merges public explainer authoring into onboarding/ or defines a separate jargon policy for engineering cards.

alternatives.option: Parse Concept Card YAML frontmatter with an ad-hoc parser or perform filesystem I/O inside models/concepts.py, or enforce jargon-before-reveal in Level-2 and Level-3 sections.
alternatives.reason: Ad-hoc YAML parsing is brittle on nested source mappings, filesystem I/O in models/ violates package-ownership purity, and blocking Level-2/3 prose on jargon order impedes formal exposition.
alternatives.reconsider_when: A future approved requirement replaces YAML frontmatter with JSON/TOML or introduces a jargon-ordering rule for Level-2/3 sections.

consequences: Leaf 05 and all later explainer stages author Concept Cards under <memory>/docs/concepts/, stage pages under <memory>/docs/stages/<stage_id>/ and visual assets under <memory>/docs/assets/, while AR onboarding/ remains untouched by rh-validate.
Every checkout bootstrapping .venv installs PyYAML>=6.0 and types-PyYAML>=6.0 and runs rh-validate inside scripts/check-quality.sh before pytest.
context: Before authoring Stage 00 explainer essays and Concept Cards, the deterministic validator suite needed an explicit boundary separating public mathematical explainer files from AR code-onboarding cards, a strict YAML frontmatter parser compatible with zero-I/O models/ and strict Pyright, and clear rules for concept graph cycles and Level-2/3 prose.
decider: Developer (rulings RH-D01, RH-D05 and RH-D07 approving RH-R04@v1)
